submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R3 at 3 cm. Among allowed candidates with acceptable lifetime performance, the simulation scan from 1–6 cm gives the best pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c: 3.750 sigma at 3 cm. This is slightly better than the runner-up, Radiator-R3 at 2 cm with 3.717 sigma, and substantially better than all simulated Radiator-R2 thicknesses. R1 is not selected because lifetime suitability was not demonstrated, while R3 has lifetime support including hydrophobic treatment and operation measures noted in the project documents.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Simulation results show the maximum recorded separation is Radiator-R3 at 3 cm with 3.750 sigma; runner-up is Radiator-R3 at 2 cm with 3.717 sigma.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 is one of the three allowed candidates; recorded selected_allowed_candidate = 1 and Radiator_R3_allowed = 1.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime.
requirements.evidence: Recorded selected_lifetime_ok = 1 and Radiator_R3_lifetime_ok = 1; project-document findings include hydrophobic treatment for R3 and dry-nitrogen operation.
Recommended thickness is 3 cm, within the specified 1–6 cm range; recorded selected_thickness_within_constraints = 1.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Radiator-R3 at 3 cm.
